create_gear_sdf: create a gear signed distance function from a 3D point using gear(p, attr)
compute_gear_sdf_gradient: compute the gradient of the gear SDF at a 3D point using gear_sdf_grad(p, attr)
compute_2d_gear_distance: compute the 2D distance from a point to a gear profile using distance2D(p, attr)
build_smooth_union_sdf: build a smooth union of two SDF values with a blending parameter using smoothUnion(a, b, k)
build_smooth_intersection_sdf: build a smooth intersection of two SDF values with a blending parameter using smoothIntersection(a, b, k)
